attributes.name: Drums of Panic
attributes.powers: When a character at your location would encounter a monster, display this card at your location. While displayed, characters at that location may recharge every ally in their hand, or reveal a hand with no allies and recharge 1 card, to evade their encounter with a monster. At the start of your turn, discard this card.
